title: 第三章 我王大彪对天发誓第四章 给师兄弟们上一课
slug: 看守废丹房三年我偷偷成仙了
lines: 圣地。
内门一百零八峰。
紫云峰。
飞仙院。
“师兄，你嘱咐我的已经办妥了。”
一个锦衣青衫的年轻弟子从外面走了进来。
“有劳师弟了。”
亭子里，一袭白衣的贵公子将手中氤氲灵茶放下。
“师兄，要我说小师妹这眼光也真够差的，居然能看上一个杂役弟子，还私自跑过去和他会面，幸好被你发现了，这要是被别人看见，传出去，指不定怎么被人笑话咱们圣地呢。”
锦衣青衫弟子从旁边坐下，忍不住吐槽道。
“师妹初入圣地，难免眼界受限，以后会好的。”
白衣贵公子语气平淡的道。
“这倒是。”那锦衣青衫弟子点了点头，随后突然想到什么，好奇问道：“对了师兄，你是怎么发现小师妹出去的？”
贵公子手上动作一顿，脸上闪过一丝不自然的神情，平静道：“师尊让我看着她，以免她修炼怠惰。”
“哦。”锦衣青衫弟子点了点头，不疑有他。
杂役峰后山。
万籁俱寂，月朗星稀。
一只只赤羽鸡警惕的在溪边河水捉鱼。
近些日子。
它们兄弟姐妹越来越少，这让它们察觉到了不对劲。
恐怕这后山出了大凶险。
两年半的平静生活已经一去不复返了。
林间草丛内。
一个鬼鬼祟祟的影子正朝着溪边靠近。
却正是秦凡。
老孟带来的消息并没有对他有什么影响。
这么点小事儿他要是都处理不好，那还修什么仙？
对于他而言。
现在没有比抓鸡更重要的事了。
现在风声越来越紧。
再不多弄点，指不定哪天这些赤羽鸡就都被监护起来了。
“哧溜！”
秦凡吸了下口水，今夜的妖丹，看着愈发肥美了。
收敛气息，小心翼翼的往草丛外摸去，不过就在这时候，秦凡神色突然一动。
刚要回头，身后忽地传来一阵寒意。
一柄剑架在了他的脖子上。
秦凡吓了一跳，他都炼气四层了，在这杂役峰上竟然还有人能悄无声息的接近他？
“别动！”
一个娇喝声响了起来。
秦凡愣了，还是个女的？
content_en:
Holy place.
One hundred and eight peaks in the inner gate.
Ziyun Peak.
Feixianyuan.
"Brother, what you asked me to do has been completed."
A young disciple in brocade and blue shirt walked in from outside.
"Thank you, Junior Brother."
In the pavilion, the noble prince dressed in white put down the dense tea in his hand.
"Senior brother, my junior sister's taste is really bad. She actually fell in love with a handyman disciple and even ran to meet him secretly. Fortunately, you discovered it. If this was seen by others and spread, people might make fun of our holy land."
The disciple in brocade and blue shirt sat down from the side and couldn't help but complain.
"Junior sister's vision will inevitably be limited when she first enters the Holy Land. It will be fine in the future."
The noble man in white said in a calm tone.
"That's true." The disciple in brocade and blue shirt nodded, then suddenly thought of something, and asked curiously: "By the way, senior brother, how did you find out that junior sister was out?"
The noble master made a movement with his hands, an unnatural look flashed across his face, and said calmly: "Master asked me to watch her to prevent her from becoming lazy in her cultivation."
"Oh." The disciple in brocade and blue shirt nodded, not doubting that he was there.
…
The mountain behind the handyman peak.
Everything is silent, the moon is bright and the stars are few.
The red-feathered chickens were vigilantly catching fish in the river.
these days.
There were fewer and fewer brothers and sisters, which made them sense that something was wrong.
I'm afraid there's a big danger in the back mountain.
Two and a half years of peaceful life are gone forever.
In the forest grass.
A sneaky shadow was approaching the stream.
But it was Qin Fan.
The news brought by Lao Meng had no impact on him.
If he can't handle such a trivial matter well, then why should he be an immortal?
For him.
There is nothing more important now than catching chickens.
Now the wind is getting tighter.
If we don't get more, maybe one day all these red-feathered chickens will be under supervision.
"Chiliu!"
Qin Fan took a sip of saliva. The demon pill looked more and more plump tonight.
He restrained his breath and carefully touched out of the grass, but at this moment, Qin Fan's expression suddenly changed.
Just as he was about to turn around, a chill suddenly came from behind him.
"Uh-huh!"
A sword was held at his neck.
Qin Fan was shocked. He was already at the fourth level of Qi Refining, but there was still someone who could approach him quietly on this Miscellaneous Peak?
"Don't move!"
A shout sounded.
Qin Fan was stunned. She was still a woman?
